flags.why: The sexual use also applies to established couples, so defining it as casual sex wrongly restricts its meaning ([usage example](https://www.phunuonline.com.vn/tu-dung-mat-hung-ngang-hong-a1573034.html)).
The clothing sense is the usual modern meaning and should precede the swaggering sense ([dictionary definition](https://vtudien.com/viet-viet/dictionary/nghia-cua-tu-x%C3%AAnh%20xang)).
This word for dice is used mainly in Southern Vietnamese and needs a regional label ([regional usage](https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/Vietnamese_language)).
